::: {#rem-graph-drawing}
#### A drawing is not the graph

A graph (@def-graph-vertices-edges) says only which vertices are the endpoints of which edges.
A drawing of it adds things that are not part of the graph:
where the points are,
how long and how curved the lines are,
and whether two lines cross.
Two drawings that put the points in different places draw the same graph,
as long as they join the same pairs of points.

Graphs here are different objects from graphs of functions (@def-graph),
just as directed graphs of relations were (@rem-graph-words).

:::
